tools.name: cottage_info
tools.description:
Basic facts about the cottage: name, beds, the most guests per booking,
check-in and check-out times, the longest stay, and where to book.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description:
Whether the cottage can be booked for a stay. Dates are ISO (YYYY-MM-DD);
"departure" is the day the guests leave, so 12 to 15 March is three nights.

When not available, "reason" says why: occupied (taken), min_nights or
max_nights (stay too short or too long; "minNights" gives the minimum),
full_w

tools.name: price_quote
tools.description:
The price of a stay in CZK, as the booking page would show it: total,
the advance to pay when booking, and the tourist tax estimate. Only for
a stay that can be booked; otherwise it says why not.
